# What "Context" Really Is {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

The pages on the brain's desk

## Context = the Desk {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="context" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #9B8EC0;"}
**Context** is everything the office stacks on the brain's desk before it starts —
your request **plus** the background pages it needs to do the job well.
:::

. . .

Your instructions, pasted documents, standing rules, relevant memory — the model's
**entire world** for that one request.

## The Big Reframe {auto-animate=true}

::: {style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.5em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.2em;"}
Output quality is mostly a **context problem**, not a **smartness problem**.
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-important}
## What this means for you
A weak answer usually means weak **context**, not a weak model.
**"Give it context" is the whole skill.**
:::
